시편-55-1.exegesis: 7. mine eye ... desire-- (compare Psa 59:10 ; 112:8 ), expresses satisfaction in beholding the overthrow of his enemies as those of God, without implying any selfish or unholy feeling (compare Psa 52:6 , 7 ).

시편-55-2.title: 시편 55장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-55-2.exegesis: PSALM 55 Psa 55:1-23 . In great terror on account of enemies, and grieved by the treachery of a friend, the Psalmist offers an earnest prayer for relief. He mingles confident assurances of divine favor to himself with invocations and predictions of God's avenging judgments on the wicked. The tone suits David's experience, both in the times of Saul and Absalom, though perhaps neither was exclusively before his mind. 1. hide not thyself, &c.-- (compare Psa 13:1 ; 27:9 ), withhold not help.
